title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine won’t enter peace talks with Russia until it has security guarantees
description: WASHINGTON (AP) — President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Ukraine won’t enter peace talks with Russia until it has security guarantees against another offensive.

title: Zelensky claims 'I'm not sure that we did something bad' in first remarks since Trump Oval Office blowup
description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky denied wrongdoing Friday night in his first public remarks since a major Oval Office argument with President Trump that cast the future of his country's conflict with Russia into doubt.

title: Diplomatic Showdown: Trump and Zelenskiy's Fiery Exchange at the White House
description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy's anticipated meeting with Donald Trump turned contentious, highlighting deep rifts over the Ukraine-Russia conflict. European allies defended Zelenskiy as he faced criticism and dismissal from the Oval Office. The discord left an essential minerals agreement unsigned, questioning future US-Ukraine relations and military aid.

title: Trump Pushes For Immediate Russia-Ukraine Ceasefire
description: Former President Donald Trump has called for an immediate ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine. He warned Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to pursue peace or risk losing U.S. support. Trump believes Russian President Vladimir Putin is open to a peace deal, despite Zelenskyy's caution regarding Russian intentions.

title: A ‘bad deal’ from the U.S. on Ukraine could set harmful precedent for Taiwan, Joly says
description: Joly was responding to the heated confrontation between the U.S. and Ukraine leaders over the European country’s war with Russia. She said China is watching the conflict as it eyes its goal of seizing Taiwan
